criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: One list under the header holds all three batches, one line each — B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row sits right on the board: a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, no navigation away.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top (rgb(224,138,60)) reads GROUT TRACKER, spanning the full width above everything else.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list starts at y=71, directly beneath the header which ends at y=51 — nothing sits between them.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: ADD BATCH is at x=1293, hard against the right end of the input (x=20, running to x=1283), exactly as drawn.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line beneath the add row; it isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the grey footer.
Your own test for this ran and went red — after a restart the batches were gone (it expected B-1041 and got an empty list).

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: Nothing on screen shows an export, and the test run covers only the header and the restart — nothing in it speaks to CSV or a header row, so I could not check this.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange status line beneath the add row reading the current mix ratio and how many batches are open
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page drops straight to the grey 'grout tracker · sandbox build' footer

gaps.title: batches do not survive a restart
gaps.expected: the batches you added still there after a restart
gaps.saw: an empty list — the test expected B-1041 and got nothing back

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); the drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so I'm treating that as the builder's call.
There's a grey footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build'; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so it's the builder's call — not a fault.
The list carries a third batch, B-1043, that isn't in the drawing's two-line mock; adding rows is the whole point, so this reads as fine, not a mismatch.
No console errors were reported on the page.
summary: Captain, the heart of it is here: the board names itself in the orange GROUT TRACKER header, lists every batch in one list directly under it, and lets you add one from the page — all three of your stated goals are met. Two of the plan's items fall short: the orange mix-ratio status line the drawing puts beneath the add row simply isn't there, and your own persistence test ran and failed — batches vanish after a restart. The CSV export I couldn't check; the tests don't touch it and there's nothing on screen for it.
